title: The man Johnny Klebitz had to stop in GTA 4
subject: johnny
description:
Was Johnny right to go after Billy? 👇

Billy Grey turned informant against his own club, and Johnny Klebitz had to decide what the brotherhood meant. Spoilers for GTA IV: The Lost and Damned.

scenes.text: Johnny Klebitz's own president sold the club out to save himself.
Billy Grey had been arrested, and years behind bars were waiting for him.
So Billy agreed to testify against The Lost, the brothers who had followed him into war.
Johnny didn't wait for a trial. In the final mission, Get Lost, he rode to Alderney State Correctional Facility.
He fought his way through the prison, and Billy Grey never testified.
When it was over, only three were left to ride: Johnny, Terry and Clay.
Johnny saved the brotherhood by killing the man who led it.
